import plotly.graph_objects as go

blocks.title: Monthly Revenue Trend
blocks.code:
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

data = df.copy()
data['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['order_date'])
data['month'] = data['order_date'].dt.to_period('M').dt.to_timestamp()
monthly = data.groupby('month', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum().sort_values('month')
fig = px.line(monthly, x='month', y='revenue', markers=True, title='Monthly Revenue Trend', labels={'month': 'Month', 'revenue': 'Revenue'})
fig.update_xaxes(dtick='M1', tickformat='%b %Y')
print(fig.to_json())

blocks.title: Monthly Revenue by Region
blocks.code:
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

data = df.copy()
data['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['order_date'])
data['month'] = data['order_date'].dt.to_period('M').dt.to_timestamp()
agg = data.groupby(['month', 'customers.region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum().sort_values('month')
fig = px.line(agg, x='month', y='revenue', color='customers.region', markers=True, title='Monthly Revenue by Region', labels={'month': 'Month', 'revenue': 'Revenue', 'customers.region': 'Region'})
fig.update_layout(xaxis_title='Month', yaxis_title='Revenue', legend_title_text='Region')
print(fig.to_json())

import plotly.express as px

agg = df.groupby('products.category', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum().sort_values('revenue', ascending=False)
fig = px.bar(agg, x='products.category', y='revenue', title='Revenue by Product Category', labels={'products.category': 'Product Category', 'revenue': 'Total Revenue'})
fig.update_xaxes(categoryorder='array', categoryarray=agg['products.category'].tolist())
print(fig.to_json())

import plotly.express as px

counts = df.groupby(['channel', 'device']).size().reset_index(name='visits')
fig = px.treemap(counts, path=[px.Constant('All visits'), 'channel', 'device'], values='visits', title='Visits by Channel and Device')
fig.update_traces(textinfo='label+value')
print(fig.to_json())
